company.name: Chief Agentic Officer
company.summary: The board-level operating role for agentic AI: ownership, boundaries, assurance, value, and human judgement in one accountable mandate.

analytics.north_star: Move qualified visitors from Tony Wood's owned topical sites to Tonywood.org advisory so public ideas turn into useful advisory conversations.
analytics.site_goal: Build demand for Chief Agentic Officer as an accountable role for agentic AI ownership, boundaries, tools, cadence, and board confidence.

briefing.name: Chief Agentic Officer Briefing
briefing.purpose: The Chief Agentic Officer Briefing helps board-facing leaders notice the UK/EU signals that may affect how agentic work is owned, governed, evidenced, narrowed, stopped, funded, or escalated.
briefing.focus: Most AI news is US-, China-, vendor-, or productivity-led. This briefing looks instead for UK and European governance, risk, compliance, resilience, disclosure, data, reputation, and board-action signals that a board-facing leader may need to understand.
briefing.guardrail: The briefing supports judgement. It does not replace legal, regulatory, audit, disclosure, financial, data protection, director, or management judgement.

briefing_categories.name: AI governance
briefing_categories.meaning: Ownership, decision rights, assurance, risk appetite, human judgement, and accountable use of AI or agentic systems.

briefing_categories.name: Cyber/resilience
briefing_categories.meaning: Cybersecurity, operational resilience, incident readiness, third-party dependency, business continuity, and systems that must keep working under pressure.

briefing_categories.name: Disclosure
briefing_categories.meaning: Signals that may affect what leaders say to boards, regulators, investors, customers, markets, or other external stakeholders.

briefing_categories.name: CSRD/ESRS
briefing_categories.meaning: European sustainability reporting, assurance, data, governance, and evidence obligations connected to CSRD and ESRS.

briefing_categories.name: GDPR/data
briefing_categories.meaning: Personal data, lawful basis, data protection, privacy, records, data movement, and data-use boundaries.

briefing_categories.name: Board actions
briefing_categories.meaning: Items that may require a board, committee, chair, company secretary, executive, or accountable owner to approve, stop, narrow, fund, review, or escalate.

briefing_categories.name: Other
briefing_categories.meaning: Signals that do not fit the named categories but may still matter for UK/EU board readiness, reputation, customer trust, or practical operating judgement.
